prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a friend to keep you company while you work or play.", "Explore Pets"]
1: ["A New Companion Awaits", "Scroll to discover how your desktop pet will assist, entertain, and interact with you daily.", "Select your main goal"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Space", "Your companion is getting ready. Review the desktop control tips below while you wait.", "Quick Controls Tip"]
3: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Click and drag to position your pet. Right-click anytime to hide or open companion settings.", "Start Interacting", "Right-click for Menu"]
4: ["Save & Protect Your Companion", "Sign in to back up your custom pet, settings, and unlock seamless multi-device sync.", "Your pet progress will automatically link to your account."]
5: ["Use clear, well-lit photos facing forward for best AI pet generation results."]
6: ["Desktop Pet Tips", "Generating pet assets..."]
7: ["We will send a quick desktop alert as soon as your companion is ready to meet you!"]
8: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Certified Companion"]
9: []
